**Key findings:** La Rochelle has two anchor tech events — **IA-NA** (AI congress, June 3, 2026 — happened today) organized by La Rochelle Université's L3I lab with ~300 attendees, and the **EBG Digital Benchmark** (October, recurring since 2023), a 2-day all-inclusive MarTech/data summit for CMOs/CDOs. Beyond those, the ecosystem runs through [Technopole ATLAS](https://technopole-atlas.fr) and [Village by CA CMDS](https://cmds.levillagebyca.com) with year-round workshops and pitch events. There's no GDG/DevFest chapter — nearest developer conference hubs are Nantes (120 km) and Bordeaux (180 km). 15 citations, citations ledger written.
